solver_task_steps.abi: context = ECX, group = EAX, dt pushed; RET 4
solver_task_steps.contract: stores the group at context+0EA68h, sizes the row block through 00C31C30 to [group+4h]*8 rows, runs the row build 00C4DE40, grows and zeroes the per-body velocity accumulators to context+4h entries, then applies the warm start through 00C42BA0

one allocation of rows*7Ch bytes carved into nine parallel arrays at context+0EA7Ch..+0EA9Ch: two of 30h bytes per row (J and M^-1 J^T) and seven of 4 (body pair, two right-hand sides, two accumulated impulses, effective mass, friction coefficient)

assigns solver body indices (static bodies all take 0), then per contact point writes one normal row at k and one friction row at k + [group+4h]*4; sets context+0EAA4h to the point count and context+0EAA8h to [group+4h]*4
per normal row, pushes M^-1 J^T * impulse into the velocity accumulator pair and M^-1 J^T * biasImpulse into the bias pair, so the first iteration starts from the previous frame's answer

two Gauss-Seidel sweeps per normal row over the same Jacobian and effective mass: the velocity row against context+0EA88h into the first accumulator pair, the bias row against context+0EA90h into the second; both clamp the accumulated impulse at zero from below
one sweep per friction row into the velocity pair only, with the accumulated impulse clamped to +/- friction[k]*impulse[k] of the matching normal row k; one friction row per contact point, not two

for solver index 1 to context+0EAA0h, adds the velocity pair to the motion state's M+00h/M+0Ch and the bias pair to M+20h/M+2Ch, then sets B+58h to -1; index 0 is the shared static slot and is skipped
walks the group's manifolds and points in the row order and copies impulse[k] to point+24h and biasImpulse[k] to point+28h, which is what the next frame warm starts from

collision_pass_steps.contract: indirect through [[scene+0ACh]+0Ch]; the SAP radix manager re-sorts its axis lists and rebuilds the overlapping-pair set. Contract only, the manager's body is not read

refreshes every manifold whose two bodies are not both asleep through 00C4B9B0, then unlinks every manifold left with zero points, decrements the container count at +1D0h and pushes the node onto the free list at +0Ch
indirect through [[scene+0ACh]+10h]; zero skips the whole IntersectLoop scope but not the notification step. 00C575AF then clears the contact-event count at scene+0DCh
indirect through [[scene+0ACh]+14h]; a pair's first two fields point at the two bodies

collision_pass_steps.contract: per event in scene+0D8h (count scene+0DCh), calls slot 0 of each body's own callback object at B+68h with the shape pair, swapped for the second body. This, not world+24h, is the shipped game's contact notification

collision_pass_steps.abi: scene = ESI, first pair = EAX, last pair pushed
collision_pass_steps.contract: per pair, every shape of body A against every shape of body B: the group/mask filter, the six-by-six dispatch table, the friction and restitution combines into manifold+00h and +04h, the point inserts, and the contact-event append under the spin lock at scene+0E4h

rejects a non-unit normal, refreshes a matched point in place keeping its two accumulated impulses at +24h and +28h, appends a new point with both zeroed, or takes the unread four-point reduction branch
the first existing point whose local point on either body is within 0.0025 squared (0.05 units) of the candidate's, or the point count
